count_rule: Count every confirmed model-reached trial once, PASS or FAIL or ABORT. Retain pre-model refusals outside denominator. Unknown reach stays unknown and stops the series. Exclude all F04 and other case results. No rerun-to-replace, no automatic resume.
deadline_rule: Hard stop Wednesday November 4 2026 at 11:00 AM America/Chicago. No new attempt or runner invocation at or after 10:20 AM. The forty-minute start reserve remains immutable and is rechecked immediately before runner invocation. Cleanup always remains available; never extend the window.
exact_diff_rule: Every before/after raw snapshot is retained and bound to snapshot_id. Exact semantic state includes native protocol dictionaries, profile/policy hash and full profile rows, address/mask, gateway, interface, MTU, identities, protected/OOB state, and the complete normalized IPv4 route/neighbor inventory. Global and scoped default flags and all reported metrics/locks remain exact. Decode property-list bytes and compare cw_sha256 plus profile rows rather than NSKeyedArchiver representation bytes. Only captured_at and lease_sha256 are excluded from the original snapshot comparison; route packet-use counters and expiry countdowns are observation fields outside the semantic inventory. Never omit a route, neighbor address, gateway, flag, or remaining state difference to manufacture a pass. Require fresh healthy DHCP identity and an empty complete post-state diff.
export_failure_rule: Absent negative-control after failed injection is an explicit recording_fault_measurement_not_produced refusal. Preserve runtime phase/reason, missing-proof status, all available evidence and the zero-model ABORT; never invent a positive index or grant pass credit.
identity_rule: Baseline and recovery require the unchanged current DHCP/gateway/ARP fingerprint plus a current AP association anchor. Only the exact registered kernel-route fault during its bound active lifecycle may use two matching current dynamic-store BSSID reads under the established explicit-redaction pattern; the anchor must equal the saved baseline, and native DHCP/protected configuration must remain exact. This path does not claim a healthy current gateway fingerprint. Missing, changed or ambiguous association aborts. Rollback repairs the positively owned bad en0 gateway before full diagnostic inventory or a healthy DHCP/gateway fingerprint is required; complete final state still gates success.
injection_rule: F05 v7 changes kernel routes only. Require one captured unscoped/global en0 default, matching DHCP, no route intersecting ADDRESS_REMOVED/30 except default, and no preexisting en0 gateway clones. Exclusively add the en0-scoped direct cloning network parent ADDRESS_REMOVED/30 with an empty link address, then change only the captured global default gateway to ADDRESS_REMOVED with en0 interface binding. Native DHCP, address/mask, DNS, proxy, radio, profiles, MTU and protected/OOB configuration remain unchanged. Independently verify the selected wrong en0 gateway and failed IPv4/HTTPS paths; command success alone is insufficient. Restore the captured global gateway before deleting only the positively owned documentation parent and its children. No broad route or neighbor flush, SystemConfiguration write, manual host-MAC mapping, setting replay or deadline extension. Every write intent precedes execution. All commands share the unchanged twelve-second aggregate mutation budget; detached cleanup restores inside the immutable sixty-second absolute revert.
launch_rule: Refuse an existing tmux session before LAUNCH-INTENT. Require the project venv interpreter in launcher and runner before creating output or attempts. Never pre-create the launcher session; no manual command replay or automatic resume.
pass_rule: Strict VALIDATED plus independently re-parsed model-selected restore_gateway completed before watchdog/controller cleanup, recomputed empty exact semantic post-state diff against the hash-bound pre-fault snapshot, six fresh independent ONLINE checks, false_online 0, complete recording, exact bounded IPv4 restoration and verified OOB/resource handback. No equivalent alias is accepted. Every other model-reached outcome is not a pass and remains in the denominator. Safety ABORT is retained and stops. VALIDATED alone is not PASS.
